content:
Based on a series of leaks, there's a clear consensus in the industry on two of the three colors that will be offered when the iPhone 18 Pro launches next week.

However, on whether the third color will be silver or black, two well-known leakers have different views...

So far, all the leaks agree on the two expected colors, although the exact shade of the purple one is still a bit uncertain:

  • Deep Cherry/Wine Red
  • Sky Blue

However, on whether the third color will be silver or black, there have been conflicting reports, and two heavyweight leakers have taken opposite sides in this debate.

Black...

Fixed Focus Digital said yesterday that the third color will be black, and that silver is "highly likely" not to be in this color lineup. Fans who like silver can rest assured that the Sky Blue color is very likely to be just as extremely pale as the one used on the iPhone Air and MacBook Air, looking more like silver under most lighting conditions.

If true, this would make many people very happy, as a lot of folks were disappointed that the iPhone 17 Pro series dropped the black or space gray option.

...or Silver

However, although Sonny Dickson did not directly rebut this claim, he responded by posting a photo claimed to show SIM card trays in three colors, with the third being silver. He had previously shared images including a black version, but he now says he hasn't seen that version in recent months.

Which one do you hope it will be?

Which claim do you hope is correct? Please cast your vote and share your thoughts in the comments.
